Every night, you dream for around two hours in total.
You just forget almost all of it within minutes of waking up.
But one big idea is memory.
While you sleep, your brain replays your day and decides what to keep.
In 2010, Harvard researchers had people learn a maze, then take a nap.
The ones who dreamed about the maze got about ten times better at it.
Dreams are a safe place to rehearse danger.
That's why so many dreams are about being chased...
What about people who are born blind?
Not in pictures, but in sounds, touch, and smells.
